name: Celebrity Cruises
notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

name: Royal Caribbean
notes: Deluxe Beverage Package is priced per sailing (~$56-105 + 18% in 2026 reports); midpoint used. VOOM $16.99-30.99/device/day (official guide). Specialty: Chops $69.99, Giovanni's $54.99 (2024) + 18%.

name: Carnival Cruise Line
notes: CHEERS! $69.95 + 20% pre-cruise; Bottomless Bubbles $11.99 + 20%; Premium (streaming) Wi-Fi $25.50/day pre-cruise. Carnival moves drink and Wi-Fi packages to per-sailing pricing from 2026-12-01. Steakhouse about $52 incl. gratuity.

name: Princess Cruises
notes: Standalone Plus Beverage Package reported at $64.99/day incl. service charge (another source says $77.99). MedallionNet $24.99/day. Crown Grill about $55 + 20%.

name: Holland America Line
notes: Signature Beverage Package from $54.95 + 18% (third-party, undated). Wi-Fi $30.99/day per Holland America's blog comparison. Pinnacle Grill about $52 (third-party).

name: Cunard
notes: Beverage Collection about $75-85.50/day depending on voyage length (third-party, 2026); Wi-Fi from $18/day. New 2026 Signature Packages (~$75/day) bundle drinks, Wi-Fi and dining credit; contents vary, not modeled.

name: Seabourn
notes: All-inclusive: drinks (most wines and spirits), Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining are in the fare, so add-on prices are not needed.

name: Norwegian Cruise Line
notes: Most fares include Free at Sea (open bar, Wi-Fi, specialty meals); the drinks service charge is $28.50/person/day. Standalone package, Wi-Fi and specialty prices not yet sourced.

name: Oceania Cruises
notes: Fares include gratuities (since 2025), specialty restaurants, Wi-Fi and simply MORE (wine, beer and champagne at lunch and dinner, excursion credit) for the first two guests. Cocktails and spirits outside meals are extra (Prestige Select upgrade).

name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises
notes: All-inclusive: drinks, Wi-Fi, specialty dining, gratuities and unlimited shore excursions are in the fare.

name: Viking (ocean)
notes: Adults 18+. Fares include wine and beer with lunch and dinner, Wi-Fi, all restaurants and the LivNordic thermal spa. Silver Spirits all-day package about $27/night. Hotel and dining service charge $20/person/day from 2026-01-01 (discretionary). No shareholder perk found for VIK.

name: Virgin Voyages
notes: Adults 18+. All restaurants, sodas, drip coffee and basic Wi-Fi included. Gratuities unbundled for Sea Terrace and below from 2025-10-07: $20/day prepaid, $22 onboard. Premium fare option adds a $15/day bar tab (not modeled).

name: Disney Cruise Line
notes: Fountain sodas included. No unlimited alcohol package is sold (drinks are bought individually). Recommended gratuities $16/person/night, $27.25 in Concierge. Wi-Fi and Palo/Remy prices not yet sourced.

name: MSC Cruises
notes: Premium Extra about $85/day pre-cruise incl. 18% service; Alcohol-Free about $30/day. Hotel service charge $17/day ($23 Yacht Club) for US-region bookings made from 2026-05-11 (was $16/$20). Bella/Fantastica/Aurea fare 'experiences' are not modeled as separate tiers.

name: Explora Journeys
notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining included; Anthology tasting menu is extra. Explora III (July 2026) not yet listed: capacity unconfirmed.

name: Silversea
notes: Butler in every suite; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included (spa service charge extra). La Dame carries a surcharge. RCL shareholder credit coverage unconfirmed. Expedition ships out of scope.

name: Azamara
notes: Gratuities, house wines, beers, spirits and soft drinks included. Prime C and Aqualina about $50 each for non-suite guests. Basic Wi-Fi inclusion is disputed between sources.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and most dining included; signature restaurants or tasting menus may be extra (sources disagree).

name: Crystal
notes: Butler for every guest; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included. Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio included with a reservation allotment (1 each up to 11 nights); unlimited for Penthouse guests.
